name: Eagle's Fist

angles.text: The lookout's note calls the spot an ideal place to launch a parachute glider. Engineers may appreciate the chance for aerial reconnaissance and mechanical flight.

faq.answer: Eagle's Fist is a lonely lookout over a weathered barricade, where a toolbox holds a folded letter. Its writer has left in haste.
An unidentified scout or sentry wrote the letter. The writer serves the Old Kingdoms and the Eagle and Fist, keeping watch at a lonely barricade.
faq.q: Who wrote the letter found in the toolbox?

aliases: what is the eagle and fist
faq.answer: The Eagle and Fist is an allegiance named in the letter. It calls for keeping a measured distance in service, and is tied to guarding what remains of the Old Kingdoms.
faq.q: What does 'the Eagle and Fist' refer to?

faq.answer: The scout left in haste, though the campfire had only recently been fed with fresh wood. The writer praised the overlook as a place to launch a parachute glider.
The letter's writer says the barricade is worn, like the fallen Old Kingdoms of humanity it once defended. Still, the watcher vows never to abandon it.
The perch offers an incredible view, and water spray dampens the air. It may be a high cliff or overlook near a great waterfall or cascading river.
faq.q: What kind of lookout post is this?

sections.body: A folded letter lies inside a toolbox at a high overlook. From here, its writer says, one can call the shots or launch a parachute glider across the land. Misty spray dampens this lonely post, but the view reaches across historic lands.
sections.title: A Hidden Perch

sections.body: The letter's writer pledges lasting loyalty to the Eagle and Fist. To serve that cause well, the writer says, one must keep a measured distance. The nearby barricade has fallen into disrepair, like the Old Kingdoms it once shielded from danger. Still, the watcher vows never to abandon the post.
sections.title: Loyalty to the Old Kingdoms

sections.body: The sentry left the overlook in a hurry. The campfire was fed with fresh wood only recently, yet the watcher is gone. Tools, burning embers and a cryptic letter remain behind.
sections.title: A Hasty Departure

summary: At a misty overlook, Eagle's Fist keeps a lonely watch over a weathered barricade. A letter speaks of loyalty to the Old Kingdoms and the Eagle and Fist, though its writer has left in haste.
